description: Pinned Scam Guard (FPL) detector-contract artifacts consumed by the CipherLayer Wallet risk layer (cipherlayer-risk). Read-only copies; never edit in place. Family convention per operator decision 2026-07-04 (register AC-001), Arrow/Tarquin PIN format.

pins.purpose: Wire format of one detector finding; mirrored by cipherlayer-risk::DetectorOutput and referenced by schemas/risk-evidence-bundle.v1.json.
Operative stable SG-* Reason Code registry validated by the subprocess adapter before findings reach wallet risk evidence.
Normative consumer obligations: preserve findings, unknown never low, conflicts visible, findings never authorize.

update_procedure: Re-copy from scam-guard exports/ at a chosen commit; update source_commit, hashes, pinned_at; run `cargo test -p cipherlayer-risk`; record semantic changes in an ADR.
